title: A Study Evaluating Disease Characteristics and Outcomes in Participants With Asthma in Routine Clinical Practice (AIRITY)
official: AIRITY: A hybrid cross-sectional and prospective study to assess patient characteristics, disease burden, disease control, phenotypes, endotypes, and outcomes in a real-world setting in patients with asthma
summary:
Main objective: Part 1:
To describe the characteristics of participants with asthma across the spectrum of disease severity, including sociodemographic and clinical characteristics, treatment and disease burden, biomarkers, and both disease-specific and generic health-related quality of life

Part 2:
Two groups of prospective cohorts are defined based on:
(A) Asthma control
To describe long term asthma control and treatment patterns for asthma control cohorts
(B) Type-2 biomarker levels
To describe lung function longitudinally for Type-2 high and Type-2 low cohorts
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Applicable for Part 1 participants:  1) Age 6 years and older, at the time of signing the informed consent
2. 2) Physician diagnosis of asthma for at least 12 months
3. 3) Existing treatment with low, medium, or high dose ICS and other asthma therapies as reflected in GINA 2-5 steps
4. 4) Participant or legally authorized representative (where applicable) has consented to participate
5. Applicable for Part 2 participants:  1) Age 18 years and older, at the time of signing the informed consent.
6. 2) Physician diagnosis of asthma for at least 12 months
7. 3) Existing treatment with low or medium ICS and other asthma therapies as reflected in GINA 2-4 steps
8. 4) Participant or legally authorized representative (where applicable) has consented to participate
9. 5) Participants must meet the criteria for at least one of the cohorts below: (A) asthma control cohorts: 1.  ACQ-5 >= 1.5 (A1: uncontrolled cohort) 2.  ACQ-5 < 1.5 (A2: controlled cohort); (B) Type-2 biomarker cohorts: 3.   Elevated T2 biomarkers (B1: Type-2-high cohort) 4.   Low T2 biomarkers (B2: Type-2-low cohort)
Exclusion criteria:
1. Applicable for both Part 1 and Part 2 participants:  1) Current diagnosis of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) or congestive heart failure
2. 2) Participants with moderate/severe cognitive impairment.
3. 3) Participants with moderate/severe cardiac disease.
4. 4) Participants on immunosuppressive medication for a chronic condition
5. 5) Participation in other interventional and noninterventional clinical study (currently or in the past 3 months)
